extension.summary: A live weather station for your TV: radar loop, future radar, forecasts, climate and fishing
extension.description: Turns an idle TV into a weather station. An animated radar loop over a map of your location, with a future-radar extension (HRRR in the US, Rainbow.ai with a free key), regional radar with NWS warning polygons, a national mosaic and satellite. Plus a rotating set of panels you switch on or off: current conditions, the next two hours, a 48-hour graph, daily forecast, today against the 1991-2020 normal, a year in temperature, a fishing forecast with solunar periods, sun and moon, air quality, tides and the NWS forecast discussion. Severe warnings show as a banner. Keyless data first; works offline from cache.
extension.disclaimer: Data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), Iowa Environmental Mesonet, NOAA (NWS, HRRR, CO-OPS, GOES via NASA GIBS), USGS, RainViewer, optional Rainbow.ai and LibreWXR. Maps © OpenStreetMap contributors © CARTO, Esri. Weather icons: Meteocons by Bas Milius (MIT). Not for life-safety decisions; follow official warnings.
